      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Download dataset\n",
        "path = kagglehub.dataset_download(\"adityajn105/flickr8k\")\n",
        "dataset_path = Path(path)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Find captions file\n",
        "captions_file = list(Path(path).rglob(\"captions.txt\"))[0]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Load captions\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(\n",
        "    captions_file,\n",
        "    sep=\",\",\n",
        "    header=None,\n",
        "    names=[\"image\", \"caption\"],\n",
        "    engine=\"python\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove header row\n",
        "df = df[df[\"image\"] != \"image\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove empty rows\n",
        "df = df.dropna().reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove #0, #1, etc. from image names\n",
        "df[\"image\"] = df[\"image\"].apply(lambda x: x.split(\"#\")[0])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Clean captions\n",
        "df[\"caption\"] = df[\"caption\"].str.strip()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove special characters\n",
        "df[\"caption\"] = df[\"caption\"].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: re.sub(r\"[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s]\", \"\", x)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert to lowercase\n",
        "df[\"caption\"] = df[\"caption\"].str.lower()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove extra spaces\n",
        "df[\"caption\"] = df[\"caption\"].apply(\n",
        "    lambda x: re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", x)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create final DataFrame\n",
        "captions_df = df.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Print information\n",
        "print(\"Total captions:\", len(captions_df))\n",
        "print(\"Total unique images:\", captions_df[\"image\"].nunique())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Show full captions\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_colwidth\", None)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nFirst 8 captions:\\n\")\n",
        "print(captions_df.head(8).to_string(index=False))\n"
      ],

        "def clean_caption(caption):\n",
        "\n",
        "    contract_dict = {\n",
        "         \"don't\": \"do not\",\n",
        "        \"doesn't\": \"does not\",\n",
        "        \"didn't\": \"did not\",\n",
        "        \"can't\": \"cannot\",\n",
        "        \"couldn't\": \"could not\",\n",
        "        \"wouldn't\": \"would not\",\n",
        "        \"shouldn't\": \"should not\",\n",
        "        \"won't\": \"will not\",\n",
        "        \"isn't\": \"is not\",\n",
        "        \"aren't\": \"are not\",\n",
        "        \"wasn't\": \"was not\",\n",
        "        \"weren't\": \"were not\",\n",
        "        \"i'm\": \"i am\",\n",
        "        \"you're\": \"you are\",\n",
        "        \"they're\": \"they are\",\n",
        "        \"we're\": \"we are\",\n",
        "        \"it's\": \"it is\",\n",
        "        \"that's\": \"that is\"\n",
        "    }\n",
        "    caption = caption.lower()\n",
        "    for contraction, full_form in contract_dict.items():\n",
        "        caption = caption.replace(contraction, full_form)\n",

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from collections import Counter\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "# 1. Build vocabulary\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "\n",
        "word_counter = Counter()\n",
        "\n",
        "for caption in captions_df[\"caption\"]:\n",
        "\n",
        "    words = caption.lower().split()\n",
        "\n",
        "    word_counter.update(words)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Minimum number of times a word must appear\n",
        "mincount = 2\n",
        "\n",
        "vocab = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for word, count in word_counter.items():\n",
        "\n",
        "    if count >= mincount:\n",
        "        vocab.append(word)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "# 2. Create word2idx\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "\n",
        "word2idx = {\n",
        "    \"<pad>\": 0,\n",
        "    \"<start>\": 1,\n",
        "    \"<end>\": 2,\n",
        "    \"<unk>\": 3\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "for word in vocab:\n",
        "\n",
        "    if word not in word2idx:\n",
        "\n",
        "        word2idx[word] = len(word2idx)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Reverse dictionary\n",
        "idx2word = {\n",
        "    idx: word\n",
        "    for word, idx in word2idx.items()\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Vocabulary size:\", len(word2idx))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "# 3. Tokenize captions\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "\n",
        "def toxenize_caption(caption):\n",
        "\n",
        "    words = caption.lower().split()\n",
        "\n",
        "    tokens = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Start token\n",
        "    tokens.append(word2idx[\"<start>\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "    for word in words:\n",
        "\n",
        "        if word in word2idx:\n",
        "\n",
        "            tokens.append(word2idx[word])\n",
        "\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "\n",
        "            tokens.append(word2idx[\"<unk>\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "    # End token\n",
        "    tokens.append(word2idx[\"<end>\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "    return tokens\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Apply tokenization\n",
        "captions_df[\"tokens\"] = captions_df[\"caption\"].apply(\n",
        "    toxenize_caption\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nCaptions DataFrame:\")\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    captions_df[\n",
        "        [\"image\", \"caption\", \"tokens\"]\n",
        "    ].head()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "# 4. Split dataset\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "\n",
        "train_df = captions_df[\n",
        "    captions_df[\"image\"].isin(train_images)\n",
        "].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "val_df = captions_df[\n",
        "    captions_df[\"image\"].isin(val_images)\n",
        "].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "test_df = captions_df[\n",
        "    captions_df[\"image\"].isin(test_images)\n",
        "].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "# 5. Print dataset sizes\n",
        "# =====================================\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTrain captions:\", len(train_df))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"Validation captions:\",\n",
        "    len(val_df)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"Test captions:\",\n",
        "    len(test_df)\n",
        ")"
      ],

        "def prepare_image(image_path):\n",
        "\n",
        "    image = Image.open(\n",
        "        image_path\n",
        "    ).convert(\"RGB\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Resize image\n",
        "    image = image.resize(\n",
        "        (224, 224)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Convert to numpy\n",
        "    image = np.array(image)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Convert 0-255 → 0-1\n",
        "    image = image / 255.0\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Normalize for ResNet\n",
        "    mean = np.array(\n",
        "        [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    std = np.array(\n",
        "        [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    image = (\n",
        "        image - mean\n",
        "    ) / std\n",
        "\n",
        "    # H,W,C → C,H,W\n",
        "    image = image.transpose(\n",
        "        2, 0, 1\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # numpy → tensor\n",
        "    image = torch.tensor(\n",
        "        image,\n",
        "        dtype=torch.float32\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return image\n"
      ],

        "def load_image(image_path):\n",
        "    image = Image.open(image_path).convert(\"RGB\")\n",
        "    image = image.resize((224, 224))\n",
        "\n",
        "    image = np.array(image).astype(\"float32\") / 255.0\n",
        "\n",
        "    # H,W,C -> C,H,W\n",
        "    image = torch.tensor(image).permute(2, 0, 1)\n",

        "class Generation_model(nn.Module):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embed_size, hidden_size, num_layers, feature_size):\n",
        "        super(Generation_model, self).__init__()\n",
        "        self.vocab_size = vocab_size\n",
        "        self.embed_size = embed_size\n",
        "        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\n",
        "        self.num_layers = num_layers\n",
        "        self.feature_size = feature_size\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Output linear layer\n",
        "        self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_size, vocab_size)\n",
        "        # Word embedding layer\n",
        "        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_size)\n",
        "        # LSTM layer: input_size is embed_size (from word embeddings)\n",
        "        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(embed_size, hidden_size, num_layers, batch_first=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Layers to project image features to LSTM hidden and cell state dimensions\n",
        "        # ResNet50 (after removing final FC) typically outputs 2048 features.\n",
        "        # The LSTM needs hidden_size * num_layers for its initial states.\n",
        "        self.init_image_proj_h = nn.Linear(feature_size, hidden_size * num_layers)\n",
        "        self.init_image_proj_c = nn.Linear(feature_size, hidden_size * num_layers)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    def forward(self, input_ids, hidden_state):\n",
        "        x = self.embedding(input_ids)\n",
        "        # Pass the (h_0, c_0) tuple to LSTM\n",
        "        output, (h_n, c_n) = self.lstm(x, hidden_state)\n",
        "        output = self.fc(output)\n",
        "        return output, (h_n, c_n)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def init_hidden(self, image_features):\n",
        "        # image_features is expected to be (batch_size, feature_size)\n",
        "        # Project image_features to initialize the hidden and cell states\n",
        "        h0 = self.init_image_proj_h(image_features).view(self.num_layers, -1, self.hidden_size)\n",
        "        c0 = self.init_image_proj_c(image_features).view(self.num_layers, -1, self.hidden_size)\n",
        "        return h0, c0\n",
        "\n",
        "    def generate_caption(self, image_features, max_length=20):\n",
        "        if not isinstance(image_features, torch.Tensor):\n",
        "            # Ensure it's a tensor and float type\n",
        "            image_features = torch.tensor(image_features, device=device).float()\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Ensure image_features has a batch dimension (e.g., (1, 2048)) if not already present\n",
        "        if image_features.dim() == 1:\n",
        "            image_features = image_features.unsqueeze(0) # Make it (1, feature_size)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Initialize the hidden state using projected image features\n",
        "        hidden, cell = self.init_hidden(image_features)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Start with the <start> token\n",
        "        input_id = torch.tensor([[word2idx[\"<start>\"]]], device=device)\n",
        "\n",
        "        caption = []\n",
        "\n",
        "        for _ in range(max_length):\n",
        "            # Pass the (hidden, cell) tuple to the forward method\n",
        "            output, (hidden, cell) = self.forward(input_id, (hidden, cell))\n",
        "            predicted_id = output.argmax(dim=-1).item()\n",
        "            if predicted_id == word2idx[\"<end>\"]:\n",
        "                break\n",
        "            caption.append(predicted_id)\n",
        "            input_id = torch.tensor([[predicted_id]], device=device) # Prepare next input\n",
        "\n",
        "        return caption"
      ],

        "import torch\n",
        "import torch.nn as nn\n",
        "from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader\n",
        "\n",
        "class ImageCaptioningDataset(Dataset):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, df, image_features_cache, word2idx):\n",
        "        self.df = df.copy()\n",
        "        self.image_features_cache = image_features_cache\n",
        "        self.word2idx = word2idx\n",
        "        self.idx2word = {idx: word for word, idx in word2idx.items()}\n",
        "        self.df = self.df[self.df['image'].isin(self.image_features_cache)].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def __len__(self):\n",
        "        return len(self.df)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def __getitem__(self, idx):\n",
        "        img_name = self.df.iloc[idx]['image']\n",
        "        caption_tokens = self.df.iloc[idx]['tokens']\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Ensure features are flattened into 1D tensors (dim_size,)\n",
        "        features = self.image_features_cache[img_name]\n",
        "        if isinstance(features, torch.Tensor):\n",
        "            features = features.squeeze()\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            features = torch.tensor(features, dtype=torch.float32).squeeze()\n",
        "\n",
        "        caption_tensor = torch.tensor(caption_tokens, dtype=torch.long)\n",
        "        return features, caption_tensor\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def collate_fn(batch):\n",
        "    # Sort batch by caption length in descending order\n",
        "    sorted_batch = sorted(batch, key=lambda x: len(x[1]), reverse=True)\n",
        "    features, captions = zip(*sorted_batch)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Stack features cleanly into (batch_size, feature_dim)\n",
        "    features = torch.stack(features)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Pad captions using the actual <pad> index instead of 0\n",
        "    pad_idx = train_dataset.word2idx[\"<pad>\"]\n",
        "    lengths = [len(cap) for cap in captions]\n",
        "    padded_captions = torch.full((len(captions), max(lengths)), pad_idx, dtype=torch.long)\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i, cap in enumerate(captions):\n",
        "        end = lengths[i]\n",
        "        padded_captions[i, :end] = cap[:end]\n",
        "\n",
        "    return features, padded_captions, lengths\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Instantiate Datasets\n",
        "train_dataset = ImageCaptioningDataset(train_df, image_features_cache, word2idx)\n",
        "val_dataset = ImageCaptioningDataset(val_df, image_features_cache, word2idx)\n",
        "test_dataset = ImageCaptioningDataset(test_df, image_features_cache, word2idx)\n",
        "\n",
        "batch_size = 64\n",
        "\n",
        "# Instantiate DataLoaders\n",
        "train_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn\n",
        ")\n",
        "val_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn\n",
        ")\n",
        "test_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Define Loss Function and Optimizer\n",
        "vocab_size = len(word2idx)\n",
        "loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=word2idx[\"<pad>\"])\n",
        "optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Training Loop\n",
        "epochs = 10\n",
        "for epoch in range(epochs):\n",
        "    model.train()\n",
        "    total_loss = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    for features, captions, lengths in train_loader:\n",
        "        features = features.to(device)\n",
        "        captions = captions.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Shift inputs and targets for teacher forcing\n",
        "        inputs = captions[:, :-1]\n",
        "        targets = captions[:, 1:]\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Initialize hidden state using image features\n",
        "        initial_hidden_state = model.init_hidden(features)\n",
        "\n",
        "        optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Forward pass through model\n",
        "        outputs, _ = model(inputs, initial_hidden_state)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Compute CrossEntropy Loss\n",
        "        loss = loss_fn(\n",
        "            outputs.reshape(-1, vocab_size),\n",
        "            targets.reshape(-1)\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        loss.backward()\n",
        "        optimizer.step()\n",
        "\n",
        "        total_loss += loss.item()\n",
        "\n",
        "    average_loss = total_loss / len(train_loader)\n",
        "    print(f\"Epoch [{epoch+1}/{epochs}], Loss: {average_loss:.4f}\")"
      ],

      "source": [
        "def generate_caption(model, feature, idx2word, max_length=20):\n",
        "    model.eval()\n",
        "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "        # Ensure feature has correct dimensions: (1, feature_dim)\n",
        "        if feature.dim() == 1:\n",
        "            feature = feature.unsqueeze(0)\n",
        "        feature = feature.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Generate sequence of token IDs from model\n",
        "        predicted_caption_ids = model.generate_caption(feature, max_length=max_length)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Convert IDs to words while skipping special tokens\n",
        "        special_tokens = {\"<start>\", \"<end>\", \"<pad>\", \"<unk>\"}\n",
        "        generated_words = []\n",
        "\n",
        "        for idx in predicted_caption_ids:\n",
        "            word = idx2word.get(idx, \"\")\n",
        "            if word == \"<end>\":\n",
        "                break\n",
        "            if word and word not in special_tokens:\n",
        "                generated_words.append(word)\n",
        "\n",
        "        return \" \".join(generated_words)"
      ],

        "    # 2. Generate caption from the aligned feature vector\n",
        "    generated_caption = generate_caption(model, feature_tensor, idx2word)\n",
        "\n",

        "    reference_captions = captions_df[captions_df[\"image\"] == image_name][\"caption\"].tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 4. Compute BLEU score\n",
        "    bleu_score = calculate_bleu(reference_captions, generated_caption)\n",
        "    bleu_scores.append(bleu_score)\n",
